Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Energy | Regional GRIDCo restores Aboadze-Anwomaso transmission line after damage by illegal chainsaw operators Source : Myjoyonline.com 26 November 2026 7:06pm ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
The Ghana Grid Company Limited (GRIDCo) has restored the 330kV Aboadze-Anwomaso transmission line to operation after completing repairs to damage caused by a fallen tree.
In a statement issued on Thursday, November 26, 2026, the company said the line was damaged a day earlier after illegal chainsaw operators felled a tree onto the transmission infrastructure.
GRIDCo said repair works were completed at approximately 12:07 p.m. on Thursday, restoring the line to full operation.
Following the incident, the company appealed to the public to help protect electricity transmission infrastructure by avoiding illegal chainsaw operations and other activities near transmission lines and associated facilities.
It said activities around the infrastructure could threaten the reliability of electricity transmission and urged the public to exercise caution.
"GRIDCo appreciates the patience, cooperation and understanding of all affected consumers during this period," the statement said.
The Aboadze-Anwomaso line forms part of Ghana's electricity transmission network.
GRIDCo has reiterated its commitment to maintaining a stable power supply and ensuring the reliability of the national transmission system.
